Hi all — quick note on the evidence and technical scope we typically require for ACE + Marketplace readiness (in prioritized order):

Mandatory / ACE intake:
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) or current SOC 2/ISO audit statements
- Company network diagram (showing where inference endpoints live relative to customer data flows)
- Data flow & retention summary (what data is sent to Redwood, how long it's retained, and purging policies)
- AWS account ID(s) and estimated ARR/contract value range for co-sell mapping
- Primary technical contact + procurement contact (email)

Recommended for listing / smoother co-sell:
- KMS/HSM usage notes (who manages keys; bring-your-own-key details)
- VPC connectivity options (VPC peering, PrivateLink, or VPC endpoints)
- Minimal latency/region constraints and any regulated-data flags (HIPAA/PHI, GDPR constraints)
- Packaging notes for Marketplace listing (AMIs, SaaS integration, or managed endpoint descriptors)

Timing: if we get the SOC2 + network diagram within 5 business days we can submit the ACE intake and expect AWS to review within ~2 weeks. Naomi/PSM will handle the submission cadence and follow-up.

Proposed slots for a 30-min handshake (PT):
- Thu 9/11 3:30–4:00pm PT
- Fri 9/12 10:00–10:30am PT
- Fri 9/12 2:00–2:30pm PT

Melanie — please confirm which works and drop your procurement contact if you can.

Thanks,
